result_text:
The export now builds `all_files.zip` from the same file names the loose text files are written under, so renaming an aspect in `config.json` no longer breaks it.

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`:

- **`exportJson`**: the `all_files.zip` entries are no longer hardcoded `aspect_*.txt` literals. Each of the five scope aspects goes through a new helper.
- **New private helper `getAspectFileListEntry(NamedSourceCodeAspect)`**: it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call used when the loose files are written, and returns the `{name, content}` pair.

With the default config the entries are unchanged and stay in the same order. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is untouched and is still written when `git-history.txt` exists.

`mvn -q -o -pl reports test` ran with no output, which I read as a pass. I did not run the renamed-aspect case end to end, and I did not add a test for it. Nothing was committed.
